subject.title: WhatsApp session stalls on long model_call: incomplete turn with payloads=0, reply never delivered

question: Should maintainers revive a narrow WhatsApp final-error delivery fix for this issue now, or move the remaining delivery semantics into the broader cross-channel fallback contract work?
rationale: Current main only partially addresses the issue: run-lifecycle stalling is improved, but the WhatsApp adapter still suppresses final error payloads. Choosing between a narrow channel patch and the broader contract issue needs maintainer ownership because an open linked PR and an assigned maintainer are already involved.

options.title: Revive a narrow WhatsApp delivery fix
options.body: Patch the WhatsApp adapter so sanitized final `isError` payloads deliver while non-final/tool errors remain suppressed, then live-verify this issue's long-model path.

options.title: Move remaining work to the durable fallback contract
options.body: Keep this issue linked to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561 and solve WhatsApp as part of the shared cross-channel final fallback semantics.

options.title: Wait for the open lane-release PR
options.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94833 first, but this will not by itself remove the current WhatsApp adapter error-payload suppression.

recommendation.title: Revive a narrow WhatsApp delivery fix
recommendation.body: Patch the WhatsApp adapter so sanitized final `isError` payloads deliver while non-final/tool errors remain suppressed, then live-verify this issue's long-model path.

likelyOwner.reason: osolmaz is the current assignee and authored the broader durable final fallback delivery contract issue that overlaps the remaining decision.
